title: Access rules between devices
description: Decide which devices may talk to each other and on which ports; traffic no rule covers follows the default rule.
searchPlaceholder: Search by address, description or order number...
caption: Active access rules

stats.epochHint: Each device gets the new version at its next routine check.
stats.hintEnforcing: Enforces the rules on this device

statusBanner.openTitle: No rules yet: every device can reach every other
statusBanner.openDesc: Until you add a rule, every device can reach the others. When you save the first rule, traffic that is not explicitly allowed is blocked.
statusBanner.enforcedDesc: Rules are turned into a filter for each device and enforced on the device itself.

defaultPolicyCard.title: What happens to traffic no rule covers
defaultPolicyCard.description: Applies to all devices in the organisation. Choose whether traffic with no rule is allowed or blocked.
defaultPolicyCard.openExpl: Traffic with no matching rule between devices that are not quarantined is allowed.
defaultPolicyCard.denyExpl: Traffic with no matching rule is dropped without notice. Every connection must be allowed by a rule.
defaultPolicyCard.confirmTitle: Change the rule for traffic with no rule?
defaultPolicyCard.confirmDesc: Right away, on every device, traffic with no rule will be allowed (or blocked, depending on your choice). The policy version goes up by one. Continue?

form.subtitle: Choose from which device to which, what kind of traffic, and what to do. Lower-numbered rules are checked first.
form.priorityHint: Lower numbers are checked first: 10 comes before 100.
form.destHint: For example 100.64.0.0/10, or 0.0.0.0/0 for any address
form.actionLabel: What to do with this traffic
form.descPlaceholder: E.g. office printers reachable from accounting
form.enabledOn: The rule is applied to devices.
form.enabledOff: The rule is kept but not applied.

delete.title: Delete rule no. {{priority}}?
delete.description: Rule {{id}} ({{source}} → {{destination}}) will be removed, and the traffic it covered falls back to the default rule. If it is the last rule, the network becomes fully open. This cannot be undone.

preview.title: Rules sent to devices and single-packet test
preview.subtitle: Check the rules each device receives and whether a packet would pass, before using the rules in production.
preview.noRulesCompiled: No rules reach this device in this direction.
preview.simButton: Check whether the packet gets through
preview.emptyTitle: No rules have been sent to this device yet
preview.emptyBody: Choose another device to see its rules.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.desc: Right now every device can talk to every other. Add the first rule to limit access.

errors.saveRule: The rule was not saved. Check the addresses and try again.
errors.deleteRule: The rule was not deleted. Try again.
errors.policyChange: Could not change the rule for traffic with no rule. Nothing was changed. Try again.
errors.simulation: The test failed. Check the addresses and port.
errors.saveTest: The check was not saved. Try again.

policyTests.title: Policy checks
policyTests.description: Things the network must always allow or block. Every new rule is checked: if it would break one, it is not saved.
policyTests.emptyBody: Run the packet test and save a result as a check.
policyTests.deleteTitle: Delete this check? Future rules will no longer have to respect it.
policyTests.savedFromSimulator: Saved as a check. Every future rule must respect this result.
policyTests.refusedTitle: Rule not saved: it would break these checks. Change the rule or delete the check.
